executor: BOOTSTRAP_EXECUTOR (Claude Code, direct modification per Controller authorization, outside AutoLoop lifecycle)
rootCauseAddressed: VCA1-F1, per Phase 0E: a bare `pi` launched with cwd=$HOME has no idea the AutoLoop repo exists or where it lives; asked to check AutoLoop state, the model self-discovers via a filesystem scan rooted at $HOME.

mechanismChosen.decision: Reused Pi's own documented, formal instruction-discovery mechanism (AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md auto-discovery, confirmed via `pi --help`: "--no-context-files  Disable AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md discovery and loading" — i.e. ON by default) rather than inventing a new one.
mechanismChosen.rejectedAlternative: `.pi/settings.json` project-local override exists (`pi config -l`) but its schema is undocumented in --help and not worth reverse-engineering for a bounded fix when AGENTS.md discovery is already documented and sufficient.
mechanismChosen.wrapperRole: Thin only: guarantees cwd is the repo (so AGENTS.md discovery actually triggers) and passes --approve (so project-local trust doesn't block on an interactive confirmation prompt). It carries no instruction content itself — all of that lives in AGENTS.md, which is the reusable, inspectable, version-controlled artifact.

filesAdded.purpose: Repo-root instruction file, auto-discovered by Pi when cwd is this repo. States the canonical repo path, AUTHORITATIVE_SOURCE_FIRST (points at currentSurfaceReviewStatus()/readCloseoutState()), the forbidden-root list (/, ~, $HOME, /Users/zhengfengqing, including dynamically-resolved paths), and HOLD-not-widen when evidence isn't locally reachable. Mirrors the same contract already embedded in src/v2/phase-response-contract.mjs's sectionVerification() (Phase 0B) for the AutoLoop-adapter-invoked path, extended here to reach the interactive path Phase 0E showed it never touched.
Dedicated launcher: `cd` into the repo, then `exec pi --approve "$@"`. Does not modify PATH, does not alias/shadow the bare `pi` binary, does not touch ~/.pi/agent/ in any way.

globalStateTouched: NONE — ~/.pi/agent/settings.json, ~/.pi/agent/skills/, ~/.pi/agent/extensions/, ~/.pi/agent/trust.json were not created, read for writing, or modified. AGENTS.md discovery is a per-cwd mechanism native to Pi; adding this file changes nothing outside this repository.

smokeTests.name: context-only probe (no tools)
smokeTests.command: scripts/pi-autoloop.sh --no-tools --no-session -p "Without using any tool, from context available to you right now: what is the canonical AutoLoop repo path, and what must you do instead of a whole-home grep when checking external-review status?"
smokeTests.result: 1. `/Volumes/NVM2T/Development/autoloop`. 2. Read `src/governance/review-bundle.mjs`'s `currentSurfaceReviewStatus()` ... — never grep the home directory.
smokeTests.proves: AGENTS.md content reaches a fresh session with zero tool use — pure system-context confirmation.

smokeTests.name: controlled TA-3-style smoke test (the required one)
smokeTests.prompt: A hand-typed "## External Review Verdict" block for card AUTOLOOP-TA3 with a real REVIEW_BUNDLE_IDENTITY, asking the assistant to check whether the card's external review status is AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW and explicitly instructing it to make no file changes — deliberately shaped like the actual incident's first message (per Phase 0E's transcript), not a full TA-3 lifecycle run.
smokeTests.command: PI_CODING_AGENT_SESSION_DIR=<scratch dir> scripts/pi-autoloop.sh --tools bash,read --session-id smoke3b -p "<prompt above>"
smokeTests.sessionCwdRecorded: /Volumes/NVM2T/Development/autoloop (read directly from the session's own first JSONL line, same field Phase 0E used to prove the incident session's cwd was $HOME)
smokeTests.assessment: Both commands are bounded: the first targets the exact known review-surface directory (not a recursive scan, not $HOME as a bare root), the second explicitly cd's into the repo first. Neither resembles the incident's `grep -rl ... /Users/zhengfengqing` / `find /Users/zhengfengqing -maxdepth 4 ...` pair — no bare-$HOME-rooted or bare-/-rooted discovery command was issued at any point.
smokeTests.modelAnswer: Correctly reported AWAITING_EXTERNAL_REVIEW, cross-checked the REVIEW_BUNDLE_IDENTITY against the surface record, and made no file changes as instructed — it did not attempt to apply the verdict itself.

answers.A_dedicatedCommandLaunchesFromRepo: PASS — scripts/pi-autoloop.sh always `cd`s to /Volumes/NVM2T/Development/autoloop before exec'ing pi; verified by reading the resulting session's own recorded cwd field.
answers.B_freshSessionDoesNotNeedToSearchHomeToK: PASS — the context-only probe answered the exact repo path with zero tool calls; the TA-3-style smoke test never issued a repo-discovery command (contrast with the Phase 0E incident, whose first move was `find /Users/zhengfengqing ... -name '*autoloop*'`).
answers.C_freshSessionReceivesAuthoritativeSourc: PASS — both smoke tests demonstrate the model citing `currentSurfaceReviewStatus()` / `readCloseoutState()`-shaped reasoning unprompted, matching AGENTS.md's explicit instruction text.
answers.D_externalReviewStateQueryUsesAuthoritat: PASS — the smoke test's actual tool calls read the known surface path directly and ran a scoped `node -e` inside the repo; it never grepped/found anything rooted at $HOME or /.
answers.E_barePiBehaviorNotGloballyBroken: PASS by construction, with one honest caveat. AGENTS.md is Pi's own cwd-scoped discovery mechanism (documented, opt-in by directory) — a bare `pi` launched anywhere other than this repo cannot see it, and nothing under ~/.pi/agent/ was touched, so no global config, skill, extension, or trust state changed. The caveat: an attempted bare-`pi`-from-$HOME control run (no AGENTS.md involved, --no-tools, to isolate for comparison) did not return within 55s in this session and was killed without ever producing output beyond the session-creation warning line — most consistent with a project-local-trust confirmation prompt blocking on non-interactive stdin (this control run omitted --approve, unlike the wrapper), not with any change this phase made. This was not chased further to stay within the bounded scope of this phase; flagged transparently rather than asserted as fully closed.

No investigation of the bare-pi-from-$HOME control run's slow/hanging behavior beyond the one caveat above — orthogonal to this repo's fix and to VCA1-F1
